thread:
claire: heads-up: planning to enable `sharded_routing_v2` tonight. want dry-run + explicit approval handshake before flip.
ops-bot: deployment window requested 23:00-00:30 PT
sam: I can own rollback during window. what's the abort criteria?
claire: abort if p95 latency +10% OR error_rate delta > 0.3% OR mismatch_ratio > 1%. start 2% for 15m, then 10% for 45m.
juan: can we run a dry_run that returns both stable and candidate route per request? want to compute mismatch_ratio offline.
marta: yes, i'll add `dry_run=routes` to /api/configs/preview and UI toggle for authors. will return sample_id + both routes.
theo: add trace attrs: `candidate_route`, `stable_route`, `config_rev`, `mismatch_reason`. sample full payloads at 0.5% and shallow counters at 100%.
ingrid: policy change: PR must include `rollout_window` label and link to `activation_playbook.md`. require author + platform ack before enabling.
claire: single-line rollback for runbook:
```
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  https://console.internal/api/configs/rollback \
  -d '{"config_name":"sharded_routing_v2","to_rev":"rev-2026-03-19-2230"}'
```
sam: adding that and a quick sanity script to compute mismatch_ratio over last 5m; will run automatically every 5m in window.
marta: i'll add a "Route diffs" chart to Config > routing_v2 and a button to export 200 sample traces for the authors+platform approvers. alerts off by default.
claire: final checklist: 1) marta: dry-run + UI block, 2) theo: traces+sampling, 3) sam: runbook+santiy script, 4) ingrid: approve PR before 21:45 PT. ops-bot will schedule. pin runbook when ready. :thumbsup:
